prompts.01-overview: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished vertical Chinese educational introduction poster (portrait 2:3) for a Codex skill, part 01-overview of a consistent three-poster series. Art direction inspired by clean Johnson & Johnson corporate red and white visual language: bright white spacious background, strong warm red typography and red geometric accents, restrained charcoal body text, premium Swiss editorial grid, polished flat infographic with subtle dimensional red pyramid motif, trustworthy and warm, no medical motifs. No brand logo, no Johnson & Johnson text, no official endorsement. It must explain the skill to a beginner. Large perfectly legible simplified Chinese typography. Use exact text only from the following copy, intelligently arrange hierarchy, generous margins, concise readable layout, avoid tiny text: "金字塔表达工作室"; "先说结论，再展开理由。"; "把零散想法，整理成读者能跟上的表达。"; "邮件与周报 / 报告与建议书 / PPT故事线 / 问题分析 / 逻辑审稿"; "在 Codex 中输入 $pyramid-studio". Add small footer 'PYRAMID STUDIO · 01 / 03'. Every line should fit, do not invent claims, no QR code, no URL.
